summary: Item 2: practiceDataCounts() now returns count = number of published, non-suppressed cells; telemetry stores it and zero_result is 1 only when that is 0. Item 5: new functions/_shared/attribution.js; every successful tool response gains top-level source and url (utm_source=mcp, utm_medium=ai-assistant, utm_campaign=<tool>) plus one trailing text block; content[0] and the counts body are unchanged. Errors carry no citation. URLs: practice_data_counts -> /data/ (hub; not verified live, only /data/api/counts is known to the code), get_provider_detail -> /providers/<slug>/, match_practice -> /match/, other directory tools and get_ehr_product_detail -> /providers/. Three existing tests that pinned the old result key set or exact EHR result were updated to allow source/url. Item 3: no client, schedule or workflow in this repo calls match_practice, list_categories, practice_data_counts x3. Only workflows are gates.yml (PR) and deploy.yml (push to main); neither calls the MCP. The caller is NOT identifiable from this repo; production UA python-requests/2.x classifies as known_crawler/bot. The repo's internal marking is a User-Agent starting with cbeg- (classifyCaller and callerIdentity in functions/mcp.js, also verify-fix-organic and the Codex UA); if the script is ours, set its UA to e.g. cbeg-smoke/1 and it logs caller_class internal, caller_kind self_test. No code change made for it since the script is not in this repo. Item 4: not computed (no production data access). Deploy route: merge to main triggers .github/workflows/deploy.yml (node --test gate, wrangler pages deploy to Cloudflare Pages project gph-mcp-server, then reads back deployed commit_hash and fails if it differs from GITHUB_SHA). PRs need required check gates.

mutations.count suppressed cells: killed after adding suppressed-with-number test (1 fail)

boundary: No merge, deploy, workflow dispatch, production write or PR. Brief branch untouched. No force-push.
